item.title: Kerberoasting End to End
item.description: A full walkthrough of Kerberoasting: enumeration, hash extraction, cracking, the targeted variant for accounts without SPNs, and the no-preauth edge case. Covers NetExec, Impacket, Rubeus, targetedKerberoast, and Hashcat.
